Job Description Summary: 
 
 Internal Tittle: Manager, PLM Developer 

 This is a hands-on individual contributor role focused on Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software developmen t

 The Manager, PLM Developer is responsible for leading the design, development, and delivery of integrated Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), master data, and analytics solutions that support business objectives and data-driven decision‑making. This role partners closely with business R&D, Quality, and Regulatory stakeholders to analyze analytical and operational requirements, develop logical data models, and deliver scalable solutions across SAP PLM(Recipe and Development Mgmt.), SAP MDG, and Master Azure /Power Platform tools, while ensuring alignment with enterprise data governance, quality, and compliance standards. The ideal candidate bridges technical development with business processes - the Manager, PLM Developer oversees the development of data analytics products, dashboards, and reports using Azure and Power BI, enabling actionable business insights.  
 
 What You'll Do for Us:  
 Analyze business formulation, specification, and regulatory requirements to develop logical data models and technical designs within SAP PLM and Master Data platforms.  
 Design, customize, configure, and test SAP PLM applications (Recipe Development, Specification Management, Property Trees) to meet R&D and product governance needs. 
 Develop custom extensions, workflows, and simplified user interfaces (e.g., SAP Fiori / UI5) to enhance formulator user experience during recipe authoring.  
 Developing data analytics products and engaging with the Data governance team to define required data quality controls and DevOps process for PLM Master data products. 
 Analyzing business processes and identifying opportunities for automation. 
 Interacting with clients or stakeholders to understand their requirements and implement suitable solutions. 
 Customizing, configuring, and testing applications to meet business needs. 
 Creating data-driven dashboards and reports using Azure, Power BI for business insights into recipe statuses, ingredient compliance, and project lifecycles. 
 Support data migration initiatives (e.g., mapping raw material and recipe specs from legacy systems like Oracle Agile P4P into SAP PLM).  
 Building workflows, automating processes and data integrity checks using Power Automate and SAP workflow tools. 
 Developing virtual agents to answer questions, take actions, or interact with systems using Power Virtual Agents. 
 Developing application and process in SAP PLM, MDG or Master Data 
 Ensuring the security and compliance of applications and data. 
 Troubleshooting and resolving issues related to Power Platform applications. 
 Providing support and training to end-users. 
 
 Qualifications & Requirements:  
 A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 
 Proven experience in developing with the Microsoft Power Platform. 
 Strong knowledge of PowerApps, Power BI, Power Automate, and Power Virtual Agents. 
 Good understanding of data modeling and database design. 
 Experience in SAP PLM development is preferred 
 Experience with Microsoft Azure is preferred. 
 Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. 
 Strong communication and interpersonal skills. 
 Familiarity with process mapping and flowcharting. 
 Excellent project management, planning and organization skills and ability to work and deliver in changing environments while adhering to specified deadlines.
 
 Reporting Relationships  
 Role reports to Senior Director, Tech & Innovation Technology
 
 
All persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form (Form I-9) upon hire.
